description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Loss Ratio (%) and TFLOPs for various configurations of the SepLLM model alongside a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a non-linear scale with specific tick marks ranging from 1e7 to 9e8 (specifically 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8). The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The plot contains five solid lines. The purple line with triangle markers, corresponding to a redacted legend entry, remains constant at a value of exactly 100 across the entire x-axis from 1e7 to 9e8. The orange line with plus markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", begins at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and ends at approximately 100 at 9e8. The dark blue line with cross markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", starts at roughly 97.1 at 1e7, increases to about 99.9 at 2e8, and remains relatively steady to finish at approximately 99.8 at 9e8. The green line with diamond markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", begins at approximately 97.5 at 1e7, climbs to about 100 at 2e8, reaches a slight peak of roughly 100.2 at 6e8, and concludes at approximately 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the red line with circle markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", starts at the lowest point of exactly 94.0 at 1e7, exhibits a steep increase to approximately 98.0 at 1e8, peaks at roughly 99.1 at 4e8, experiences a dip to about 98.5 at 5e8, and ends at approximately 98.7 at 9e8.
